title: Saffron Risotto
author: Lorenzo
description: Risotto alla milanese: golden with saffron, rich with butter and parmesan.
steps: Dissolve the saffron in a ladle of the hot broth.
Soften the onion in half the butter, add the rice and toast for 2 minutes, then the wine.
Add the hot broth a ladle at a time, stirring; halfway through, add the saffron broth.
After 16–18 minutes, take it off the heat and stir in the rest of the butter and the parmesan. Rest for 2 minutes.
